verdict.rationale: Lambda's evidence shows no first-party event-rule or automation engine where users define triggers that automatically run actions. The closest items are adjacent: webhook notifications limited to support-ticket events (a building block for an external consumer, not a rule engine), static firewall rules, launch-time cloud-init, and Slurm job scheduling. A community user's request for default auto-stop went unanswered, and the agent tooling is an unofficial third-party project.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
